trips.routeDetail:
BUS COMPANY NOTE
1. Arrival times are approximate and depend on weather conditions and traffic conditions (during the day, the bus may arrive 1-2 hours late, and at night it may arrive 1-2 hours early compared to the scheduled time).

2. All Trong Minh buses depart from the Western Bus Station. Buses showing 303 Tran Phu, District 5 as the pick-up point are shuttle buses that take passengers from Tran Phu to the Western Bus Station. Please arrive 30 minutes before departure time to board the shuttle bus.

3. For buses that do not show Tran Phu as the pick-up point, please travel to the Western Bus Station to depart.

4. For private rooms: No child policy applies, maximum 2 people per room regardless of age or size.
5. For double rooms, 1 guest can be accompanied by a baby under 120cm. Over 120cm tall, double room rate applies (not applicable with promotional tickets).
6. Checked baggage: Each passenger is allowed to check in 1 piece of baggage with a maximum weight of 20kg, packed together in one piece and not separated. If baggage exceeds the weight limit, passengers will have to pay extra excess baggage fees. Checked baggage dimensions must not exceed 60cm x 40cm x 20cm.
7. THE BUS COMPANY DOES NOT ACCEPT PETS IN ANY FORM. IF PASSENGERS INTENTIONALLY BRING PETS, THE BUS COMPANY HAS THE RIGHT TO REFUSE TRANSPORTATION OF PETS OR PASSENGERS WITHOUT REFUNDING THE TICKET.
Note Regarding Complaints: For the best support, please submit your feedback or complaint (if any) within 24 hours of the end of your trip. After this time, the transportation company reserves the right to refuse to process any complaints to ensure objectivity. We appreciate your understanding.

Thank you sincerely.
